items.title: TreVeyon Henderson: Sitting out Saturday's practice
items.body_text: Henderson (ankle) was in street clothes ahead of Saturday's practice, Andrew Callahan of the Boston Herald reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: TreVeyon Henderson: Could practice Saturday
items.body_text: Henderson (ankle) could return to practice Saturday, Evan Lazar of the Patriots' official site reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Puka Nacua: Making progress in recovery
items.body_text: Nacua (groin), per head coach Sean McVay, is "making good progress" in his recovery, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Josh Jacobs: Court date moved up
items.body_text: Jacobs' next court date has been moved up from Nov. 17 to Sept. 10, Michael Gross of Fox 11 Green Bay reports. Jacobs is expected to be represented by his attorney and won't personally appear at the hearing. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
